minimumWindow.countingRule: Count a close once only when all five channels have an assessed or explicitly insufficient-conditioned-history record under the frozen input contract; repeated runs for one close do not add observations.
minimumWindow.extension: The window extends whenever a required assessment is missing, evidence integrity is unresolved, regime coverage is judged inadequate, or a deterministic discrepancy remains unexplained. Thirty closes is a minimum, never a forced completion point.

requiredGates.requirement: All methodology artifacts, references, fixtures, canonical hashes, and evidence identities pass the Session 17 validator.
Every repeated run over identical canonical inputs is byte-identical after exclusion of no fields; acquisition time belongs to the input manifest.
requiredGates.failureEffect: blocks cutover and requires explanation or rejection

requiredGates.requirement: No legacy, production, workflow, project-log, public, or private frozen-evidence path is modified by v2 execution.
All automatic cluster joins satisfy an allowed exact-match rule; every ambiguous proposal is persisted and human-confirmed or remains excluded.
Raw candidate identity, assignment history, cluster lineage, corrections, and input/configuration hashes are recoverable for every run.
Signal, market, and divergence outputs expose typed pending, insufficient, and unknown states without fallback or causal wording.

Observed channel coverage, threshold availability, trigger rates, set transitions, driver concentration, breadth, signal selection, and divergence-state counts are reported for the complete window without post-freeze tuning.
requiredGates.failureEffect: may extend the window or reject 2.0.0

requiredGates.requirement: A reviewer independent of this first freeze pass reruns the post-freeze validator and signs the artifact/evidence identities before Session 18 begins.
Deferred durable-storage, retention, and recovery controls are resolved before any public cutover.
requiredGates.failureEffect: does not block isolated implementation; blocks cutover

decisionOutcomes.accept: Only after every gate passes and a separate cutover authorization is recorded.
decisionOutcomes.extend: Continue parallel observations without changing frozen parameters when evidence is insufficient or unstable.
decisionOutcomes.reject: Issue a new methodology version; do not silently patch 2.0.0 or back-edit its evidence.

preImplementationGate: This first-pass validation does not satisfy PA-08. Session 18 may begin only after the separately recorded independent post-freeze validation passes.
